install: for u in https://pypi.org/simple/numpy/ https://files.pythonhosted.org/ https://github.com/ https://registry.npmjs.org/ https://deb.debian.org/debian/; do echo "$u $(curl -s -o /dev/null -m 10 -w '%{http_code}' $u)"; done; id -u; sudo -n true && echo SUDO_OK; which clang gcc cc tcc llvm-config pip3 uv node; python3 -c 'import sys;print(sys.version)'; python3 -c 'import numpy;print(numpy.__version__)'; ls /usr/lib/python3/dist-packages | head -30; echo PROBE_DONE; exit 1
